title: 第5章 洗脚，再次涨停，日盈十一万
novel_title: 县城：女友出国要我卖房，给脸了
content_zh:
酒桌上，刚认识的朋友，几杯酒敬下来，就能熟络了。

    五个人谈天说地，讲的都是本地趣事。

    比如杨刚、刘河、孙明他们就见到的最多。

    毕竟职业摆在那里，每天都遇到比较奇葩的事情。

    就连李西朋都有趣事说。

    只有李西海刚回来，他只有听着。

    这场喝到凌晨十二点，期间，李西海与刘河，孙明他们都互加了好友。

    “西海同志，有什么事情打我电话。”

    “哈哈，我也是，有事电话联系，没事也可以出来吹吹牛。”

    两个人都喝高兴了，也是性情中人。

    毕竟，性格不一，也跟杨刚玩不到一起。

    “西海兄。”

    杨刚搂着李西海的肩膀，醉醺醺道：“明天我还要上班，下场就不陪你了。”

    “等关总，罗子他们回来，刚好是周五，到时候再喝一场。”

    李西海点头道：“行。”

    “路上慢点。”

    他们都没开车，县城就这么大，打个车就回去了。

    目送三人离开，李西朋这个无业游民，道：“哥，走去洗脚。”

    两人来到天逸会所。

    看得出来，李西朋是常客，直接喊号。

    “哥，挑技师，哪个漂亮点哪个。”

    他点的技师倒是很不错，李西海打了个酒嗝，在几个技师间来回的扫视，最终选了一个。

    “哥，很高兴为你服务，我是888号技师。”

    技师拎着箱子躬身，李西朋听到后，问道：“你是新来的？”

    “我记得888号不是你啊。”

    “哥，我是新来的。”

    李西海躺在床上，没有说话，酒劲上来，有点晕。

    “哥，试试水温。”

    李西海放下脚试了试，“可以。”

    “哥，先泡脚，我给你按按。”

    “嗯。”

    技师上来扶起李西海，然后坐到身后，李西海靠在技师身上。

    一股香味跟柔软传来。

    李西海有点蠢蠢欲动，他也不是什么正人君子，当然也不是胡搞乱搞的。

    只是来这里消费，该享受的服务要享受。

    就在这时。

    另外一头传来嬉闹的动静。

    李西海看了一眼，李西朋这勾八拉起被子挡住这边，跟技师裹在一起。

    还听到李西朋说着，“摸一下，就摸一下。”

    这是他么来洗脚放松的啊。

    “你们会所也这样？”

    李西海收回目光，问了一句。

    脑袋后的技师也看了那边。

    “不是，我们是正规足浴会所，只是那位哥跟技师熟悉。”
content_en:
At the wine table, friends who have just met can become familiar with each other after a few glasses of wine.

    The five people chatted and talked about local interesting things.

    For example, Yang Gang, Liu He, and Sun Ming were the ones I saw the most.

    After all, the profession is there, and weird things happen every day.

    Even Li Xipeng had interesting things to say.

    Only Li Xihai had just returned and he could only listen.

    The drinking lasted until twelve o'clock in the morning. During this period, Li Xihai, Liu He, and Sun Ming all added each other as friends.

    "Comrade Xihai, call me if you need anything."

    "Haha, me too. If you have anything to do, call me. If you have nothing to do, you can come out and brag."

    Both of them were happy and in good temper.

    After all, they have different personalities, and they can't get along with Yang Gang.

    "Brother Xihai."

    Yang Gang put his arm around Li Xihai's shoulders and said drunkenly, "I have to go to work tomorrow, and I won't be with you at the end."

    "Waiting for Mr. Guan, Luo Zi and the others to come back. It happens to be Friday. Let's have another drink then."

    Li Xihai nodded and said, "Okay."

    "Slow down on the road."

    None of them drove. The county is so big, so they just took a taxi and went back.

    After watching the three people leave, Li Xipeng, an unemployed vagrant, said, "Brother, go and wash your feet."

    The two came to Tianyi Club.

    It was obvious that Li Xipeng was a regular customer and he called directly.

    "Brother, choose the technician, which one is more beautiful."

    The technician he ordered was quite good. Li Xihai burped and glanced back and forth among several technicians before finally choosing one.

    "Brother, I'm glad to serve you. I am technician No. 888."

    The technician carried the box and bowed. After hearing this, Li Xipeng asked, "Are you new here?"

    "I remember that number 888 was not you."

    "Brother, I'm new here."

    Li Xihai lay on the bed without saying anything. He was a little dizzy after drinking too much.

    "Brother, try the water temperature."

    Li Xihai put his foot down and tried, "Okay."

    "Brother, soak your feet first, and I'll massage them for you."

    "Yeah."

    The technician came up and helped Li Xihai up, then sat behind him, with Li Xihai leaning on the technician.

    A scent and softness came.

    Li Xihai is a little bit impatient. He is not a gentleman, and of course he is not messing around.

    Just come here to spend money and enjoy the services you should enjoy.

    Just then.

    There were playful sounds from the other end.

    Li Xihai took a look and saw that Li Xipeng pulled up the quilt to block this side and wrapped himself with the technician.

    I also heard Li Xipeng say, "Touch it, just touch it."

    This is where they come to wash their feet and relax.

    "Is your club like this too?"

    Li Xihai looked away and asked.

    The technician behind his head also looked over there.

    "No, we are a regular foot bath club, but the guy is familiar with the technician."
title_en: Chapter 5 Wash your feet, hit the daily limit again, make a daily profit of 110,000
